## Malapportionment and representation bias around the world

From *Distorted Democracies* (Beramendi, Boix, Guinjoan &amp; Rogers): malapportionment (Samuels &amp; Snyder index) alongside the two representation-bias measures from the paper — **MRB** (the share of ideological bias attributable specifically to malapportionment) and **TRB** (total representation bias). Switch between metrics and between lower/upper chambers, search or click a country for its exact value.

:::

```{=html}
<div class="embed-wrap surface-card">
<iframe src="maps/widgets/distorted_democracies_map.html" loading="lazy" title="Interactive map of malapportionment and representation bias by country" style="height:min(75vh, 720px);"></iframe>
</div>
```

::: embed-footnote
Country-level averages computed from the paper's own replication dataset (`MAL_countries.dta`), following the same aggregation used to produce Figure 1 of the paper ("Malapportionment in the World"). Grey countries have no data for the selected metric/chamber.
:::

## Malapportionment and ethnic minority representation

From *Electoral institutions, malapportionment and the representation of ethnic minorities* (Guinjoan, Mas &amp; Roura): malapportionment alongside the presence of ethnic minorities across legislative districts (lower chamber). Countries marked with a red cross have constitutionally reserved seats for ethnic minorities.

:::

```{=html}
<div class="embed-wrap surface-card">
<iframe src="maps/widgets/ethnicity_map.html" loading="lazy" title="Interactive map of malapportionment and ethnic minority representation" style="height:min(75vh, 720px);"></iframe>
</div>
```

::: embed-footnote
Country-level averages computed from the paper's own replication dataset (`mal_ctr_merge`), reproducing the logic of the paper's Figure 1 and Figure C1 maps. Lower chamber only. Grey countries have no data.
:::
